source.member: Healer.GetHealAmount(Player healer, Player target, uint missingVital, out bool criticalHeal, out uint staminaCost)
source.notes: ThreadSafeRandom seeded with new System.Random(seed) by reflection. in: current = the healer's Healing CreatureSkill.Current (ACE's); healkit = the kit's HealkitMod (PropertyFloat 100); missing = missingVital; stamina = the healer's Stamina.Current (the MaxStamina record's CurrentLevel); rating = the target's GetHealingRatingMod() (ACE's, from in.boost/in.resist = HealingBoostRating/HealingResistRating, null = unset). out = [heal amount, criticalHeal, staminaCost, ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 1000000) after the call].
